summary: Sokoban walls were running-bond brickwork, two courses to a tile with the upper course's head joint at half a tile, so the bricks' joints fell between the builder's A–G column labels and the floor's grid lines and the walls looked offset by half a square, in the builder and the player alike. Each wall is now one block to its square: a dark fill with its mortar an even border on the square's own four edges.
